title: Our Team
metaDescription: The team behind the Global Reasoning Challenge.
body:
Home / Team
Who runs GRC

Our Team

A globally distributed group of volunteers and professionals, working alongside a growing network of student ambassadors.

Leadership Team

Sets the direction of the competition, oversees partnerships and financial aid, and coordinates the organizing team across countries and time zones.

Academic Committee

Writes and reviews every problem across all three rounds, calibrates difficulty by age group, and selects the research paper used in the Semi-Final Round.

Ambassador Network

Hundreds of student and alumni ambassadors run local outreach in their own countries and schools — see Become an Ambassador to join them.

Want to get involved?

GRC is run largely by volunteers who started out as participants. If you would like to help write problems, support outreach in your region, or otherwise contribute, start with the Ambassador Program or reach out via Contact.
